what: Append-only supplement for SL-1 (Robin, 2026-10-19: every line spoken). Lines the game's own code shows, now under stable scene ids: the prologue's six captions (prologue), shut doors (code.door), marked objects (code.prop: the Old Mill's notice among them), every line of the six field puzzles (code.fw: the swinging screen and its clamp in Reedwake among them), every oral-history fragment at each learner level, in its teller's voice (code.history: Old Yasu's story of Reedwake among them), and every battle line (code.battle: each creature's intro, its line once settled, phase lines, each map's own). New ids only (VOICE_DELIVERY.md §8). Not part of the running batch; recorded after it, with each speaker's accepted voice, delivery and encoding.
authorization: Robin, 2026-10-19: 'every line in-game should have spoken lines with properly highlightable text as well. This goes the same for the Records section'; 'the closed door in Reedwake. The Narrator can effectively read that one; check for others similar'; 'The swinging board between Old Yasu and Ren in Reedwake, along with its clamp - no Narrator speaking. Old Yasu's story, when listening, has not begun being spoken.'; 'After defeating an enemy, the Narrator does not voice the dialogue given. The signpost inside the Ashinose Mill does not have voiced dialogue.' Nothing here generates audio.
